purpose: Replay corpus for the SDD-OS evolution (vault/plans/sdd-os-evolution-2026-10-01.md, W1). Labels are expectations of a CORRECT system, not of the current one. Cases the current code gets wrong are named in known_red; the set may only shrink.

labelling.tier_min / tier_max: acceptable tier range. tier < tier_min is a false downgrade; tier > tier_max is a false escalation.
labelling.risk: risk dimensions a correct classifier must report: destructive_data, public_contract, auth_secrets, production, irreversible_external. [] means none is required.
labelling.source: real = a prompt from ~/.claude/history.jsonl, redacted (paths, hosts, domains, names, keys replaced by <placeholders>); synthetic = written for a defect (D1-D6) or an audit gap.
labelling.deferred: write-gate cases land in W5 with hooks/sdd_write_gate.py; no producer yet. LEGACY readiness cases landed in W3 (R-10..R-13, X-10, X-11).
labelling.today: optional ISO date pinned into readiness/decision cases whose answer depends on the legacy window, so the corpus does not flip on its own when the calendar crosses it.
labelling.expect_spec: binding cases: the spec stem that must be resolved; null means NO spec_path may be reported.
